songs.title: What Have You Got?
songs.purposeAr: الملكية وما لدى كل شخص
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep I've got distinct from I have; finish the final sounds in job and got.

examples.english: I have a good job.
I've got a job.
Tom finally got a job.
You have a good memory.
Tom also has a house in Boston.
examples.arabic: لدى توم أيضًا منزل في بوسطن.

examples.english: Tom has a lot of good ideas.
Do you have a girlfriend?
Do you have anything in the refrigerator that I can eat?
examples.arabic: هل لديك شيء في الثلاجة يمكنني أكله؟

examples.english: Do you have something to make this headache go away?
examples.arabic: هل لديك شيء يخفف هذا الصداع؟

examples.english: I don't have anything to eat.
I have nothing to do.

practice.transferCue: Say one thing you have.

songs.title: Right Here in My Hand
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-002 - Right Here in My Hand
songs.purposeAr: الإشارة وتسليم الأشياء
songs.pronunciationFocus: Stress this for what you show; keep the words here and your distinct.

examples.english: Here are your keys.
Here is your book.
I brought you some food.
Hand me that bag.
What color is your car?
This is your last chance.
This is something Tom made for you.
That's a good picture of you.
This is rather expensive.
examples.arabic: هذا باهظ الثمن إلى حد ما.

examples.english: This is quite new to me.
This is pretty amazing.
This is so good.

practice.transferCue: Name one thing you can point to.

songs.title: What's the Place Like?
songs.purposeAr: وصف المكان والجو وحالة الأشياء
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep just, already and still audible; let place and weather adjectives carry the beat.

examples.english: It's still not ready.
It's just a game.
It's already open.
Everything is okay.
It's very dusty in here.
This place is really noisy.
This room is too dark.
Everybody's in bed.
According to the thermometer, it's 30 degrees outside.
examples.arabic: وفقًا لمقياس الحرارة، تبلغ الحرارة في الخارج ثلاثين درجة.

examples.english: How's the weather where you are?
It's rather cold for April.
examples.arabic: الجو بارد بعض الشيء بالنسبة إلى شهر أبريل.

practice.transferCue: Describe the room you are in.

songs.title: Words for Who We Are
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-004 - Words for Who We Are
songs.purposeAr: التعريف بالأشخاص ووصفهم
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep be joined to its subject and make the endings in student, speaker and doctors clear.

examples.english: Who are the others?
What sort of person is Tom?
examples.arabic: أي نوع من الأشخاص هو توم؟

examples.english: Are you a student?
You are my best friend.
I come from a long line of doctors.
examples.arabic: أنحدر من عائلة توارثت الطب عبر أجيال.

examples.english: Tom is a native speaker of French.
I was a student at that time.
Tom became a policeman.
Tom was a troubled child.
Tom was here too.

practice.transferCue: Say one thing about yourself.

songs.title: The Things I Like
songs.purposeAr: ما نحبه وما لا نرغب فيه
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep don't audible and give the thing you like or want the main stress.

examples.english: I like England.
I especially like your chocolate cake.
examples.arabic: أحب كعكة الشوكولاتة التي تصنعها على وجه الخصوص.

I love cats.
I don't want an apple.
I want a dog.
I'd prefer meat to fish.
Do you like Mexican food?
What's your favorite movie?
Do you like to watch movies?

practice.transferCue: Say one thing you like today.

songs.title: Tea at the Table
songs.purposeAr: الدعوة وتقديم الضيافة والطلب
songs.pronunciationFocus: Sing would you as two clearly recoverable words; let the item or invited action carry the stress.

examples.english: Would you like a cup of tea?
examples.arabic: هل ترغب في كوب من الشاي؟

examples.english: Would you like to ask me something else?
examples.arabic: هل تود أن تسألني عن شيء آخر؟

examples.english: I'd like some water.
Do you want me to buy you a drink?
examples.arabic: هل تريدني أن أشتري لك مشروبًا؟

examples.english: What do you want to drink with your meal?
examples.arabic: ماذا تريد أن تشرب مع وجبتك؟

examples.english: Are you ready to order?
Are you ready for dinner?
How would you like to pay?

practice.transferCue: Offer a drink or a snack.

songs.title: Time to Get Up
songs.purposeAr: عادات اليوم من الصباح إلى النوم
songs.pronunciationFocus: Let frequency and time expressions keep their own stress; keep third-person -s in brushes and sleeps.

examples.english: I go to school five days a week.
examples.arabic: أذهب إلى المدرسة خمسة أيام في الأسبوع.

examples.english: I usually wake up at six.
I always brush my teeth before I go to bed.
examples.arabic: أنظف أسناني دائمًا قبل أن أخلد إلى النوم.

How many times a day do you feed your dog?
examples.arabic: كم مرة في اليوم تطعم كلبك؟

What time do you usually get up on Saturday?
examples.arabic: في أي وقت تستيقظ عادة يوم السبت؟

examples.english: Tom often eats in bed.
examples.arabic: كثيرًا ما يأكل توم في الفراش.

examples.english: Tom always brushes his teeth after meals.
examples.arabic: ينظف توم أسنانه دائمًا بعد الوجبات.

examples.english: Tom usually sleeps in this room.
examples.arabic: ينام توم عادة في هذه الغرفة.

practice.transferCue: Say what time you usually get up.

songs.title: How Often Do You?
songs.purposeAr: وصف تكرار العادة في الحياة اليومية
songs.pronunciationFocus: Give often, seldom, rarely and hardly ever enough space to sound distinct.

examples.english: I seldom drink coffee.
I often go to the movies.

I sometimes watch TV.
I never liked being at home alone.
examples.arabic: لم أحب قط البقاء في المنزل وحدي.

examples.arabic: نادرًا ما كنت أراه في المدرسة.

examples.english: Tom almost always wears dark clothes.
examples.arabic: يرتدي توم ملابس داكنة في معظم الأحيان.

examples.english: Sometimes you surprise me.
Tom seldom speaks to me anymore.
examples.arabic: صار توم نادرًا ما يتحدث معي.

examples.english: Tom hardly ever listens to the radio.
examples.arabic: نادرًا جدًا ما يستمع توم إلى المذياع.

examples.english: Tom sometimes appears on TV.
Tom almost never watches TV.
examples.arabic: لا يكاد توم يشاهد التلفاز أبدًا.

practice.transferCue: Say how often you watch something.

songs.title: A Little About Your Day
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-009 - A Little About Your Day
songs.purposeAr: السؤال عن الشخص وعاداته وتوزيع أدوار اليوم
songs.pronunciationFocus: Give the first word of each question a light pickup; keep does, don't and only clear.

examples.english: Exactly what kind of work do you do?
examples.arabic: ما نوع العمل الذي تقوم به بالضبط؟

examples.english: What kind of books do you read?
Do you often take business trips?
Am I late?
Whose turn is it to cook tonight?
examples.arabic: على من يقع دور إعداد العشاء الليلة؟

examples.english: Don't you have friends?
I barely know her.
Does Tom speak French fluently?
I can still remember a little French.
examples.arabic: ما زلت أتذكر قليلًا من الفرنسية.

examples.english: Tom only drinks coffee.
Tom never dates older women.
examples.arabic: لا يواعد توم نساء أكبر منه سنًا أبدًا.

practice.transferCue: Ask someone one question about their habits.

songs.title: Look Around the Hotel
songs.purposeAr: وجود الأشخاص والأشياء والأماكن
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep there is and there are distinct; sing plural endings in boats, books and people.

examples.english: There is a bank in front of the hotel.
At one time, there was a bridge here.
examples.arabic: كان يوجد جسر هنا في وقت من الأوقات.

examples.english: There are a lot of books in the library.
There are too many people in this room.
examples.arabic: يوجد عدد أكبر من اللازم من الناس في هذه الغرفة.

examples.english: There are a few boats on the lake.
There are many books on this subject.
examples.arabic: توجد كتب كثيرة عن هذا الموضوع.

examples.english: There are a lot of things for us to think about.
examples.arabic: هناك أشياء كثيرة علينا التفكير فيها.

examples.english: There's someone outside.
There's a lot of traffic here in the mornings.
examples.arabic: توجد حركة مرور كثيفة هنا في الصباح.

examples.english: There is no food.

practice.transferCue: Say what there is near your home.

songs.title: Is There One Nearby?
songs.purposeAr: السؤال عمّا يوجد قربنا
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep the opening is there and are there audible; pause before any extra detail in a long question.

examples.english: Where is an ATM?
Is there any place around here where we can get something to eat?
examples.arabic: هل يوجد مكان قريب يمكننا تناول شيء فيه؟

examples.arabic: هل توجد آلة صراف آلي بالقرب من هنا؟

examples.english: Was anyone in the room?
Are there any cute girls in your class?
examples.arabic: هل توجد فتيات جميلات في صفك؟

examples.english: Is there anyone here who can speak French?
examples.arabic: هل يوجد هنا أحد يتحدث الفرنسية؟

examples.english: There's almost no milk left in the glass.
examples.arabic: لم يبقَ في الكأس حليب يُذكر.

examples.english: There's plenty of time.
There's no place to hide.

practice.transferCue: Ask if there is a shop nearby.

songs.title: Right on the Map
songs.purposeAr: السؤال عن مكان واتجاه الحركة
songs.pronunciationFocus: Let where keep its own vowel; place the stress on the destination and keep exactly clear.

examples.english: Exactly where are we going?

Where is Tom going?
Where did I put my keys?
Where should I put my coat?
What's the name of this place?
Can you tell me how to get to the train station?

examples.english: Can you show me where the bathroom is?
examples.arabic: هل يمكنك أن تريني أين الحمام؟

practice.transferCue: Ask where you should put something.

songs.title: What Time Is It For Us?
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-013 - What Time Is It For Us?
songs.purposeAr: الساعة والمواعيد الثابتة والقادمة
songs.pronunciationFocus: Stress the hour or event; sing 2:30 as two thirty, and keep the question openings distinct.

examples.english: What time does the restaurant close?

examples.english: What time do you think Tom will be back?

examples.arabic: متى ينبغي أن آتي لاصطحابك غدًا؟

examples.english: What time should I check in?
examples.arabic: في أي وقت ينبغي أن أسجل وصولي؟

examples.english: What time are you meeting Tom?
When are we going to do it?
When are we leaving?
Tom will arrive in Boston at 2:30.
examples.arabic: سيصل توم إلى بوسطن في الثانية والنصف.

practice.transferCue: Ask what time a place closes.

songs.title: How Much Is It?
songs.purposeAr: السعر والنقود والرسوم
songs.pronunciationFocus: Distinguish much from many and stress cost, cash and shoes; keep the embedded order in how much it costs.

examples.english: About how much will it cost?
Do you know how much it costs?
How much are these shoes?
How much cash do you have on you?

How much money do you have with you now?

examples.arabic: في هذه المرحلة، لا أحتاج إلى المال.

examples.english: I don't care about the price.

practice.transferCue: Ask how much something costs.

songs.title: Put It Right Here
songs.purposeAr: تعليمات يومية مباشرة للمكان والحركة
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep short commands separate; give clear final sounds to seat, shelf and room.

examples.english: Return to your room.
Go back to your seat.
Come back to the house.
Put it on the shelf.
Put away your toys.
Clean up your room.
Look at the picture on the wall.
Put on this sweater.
Bring your children with you.
Get me a towel.

practice.transferCue: Give one clear instruction at home.

songs.title: Don't Forget the Door
songs.purposeAr: النهي والتنبيه وتذكير شخص بفعل
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep don't and not distinct, and give the last important word a complete sound.

examples.english: Don't forget to lock the door.

examples.english: Don't leave your glasses on the table.
Get out of the water.
Be careful when crossing the street.
Keep away from the fire.
Stay away from the fire.

practice.transferCue: Remind someone to do one thing.

songs.title: May I Come In?
songs.purposeAr: الاستئذان في الصف والأماكن العامة
songs.pronunciationFocus: Emphasize I or we for who acts; keep the is it okay opening light and clear.

examples.english: Can I ask a question?

May we speak in private?
Is it okay if we swim here?
Is it okay to sing here?
Am I allowed to be in here?
For now, Tom can stay here.
examples.arabic: يمكن لتوم البقاء هنا في الوقت الحالي.

Do you mind if I open the window?

examples.arabic: هل سيكون من المقبول ألا أدعو توم إلى حفلتي؟

examples.english: Can you help me with my school project?

examples.english: Would you mind closing the window?
Can anybody tell me how to do this?
examples.arabic: هل يمكن لأي شخص أن يخبرني كيف أفعل هذا؟

examples.english: Can you explain this to me?

practice.transferCue: Ask someone to help you with a task.

songs.title: I Can Give It a Try

songs.title: We Can Do This Together
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-020 - We Can Do This Together
songs.purposeAr: اقتراح نشاط مشترك والبدء به

Let's clean up this mess.
Let's try to treat each other with respect.
Let's be friends.

songs.title: Let Me Take a Turn

songs.pronunciationFocus: Make me, us and Tom sound distinct after let; let the base verb come through.

examples.english: Let me tell you my plans.

Let me know if you find anything.
Let us know when you'll be coming to Boston.

songs.title: I Want To Tell You
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-022 - I Want To Tell You

songs.title: Did You Do It?

songs.title: How Was It Then?

songs.title: How Long, How Far?
songs.purposeAr: قياس الطول والمسافة والعمر والمدة

practice.transferCue: Ask how far a place is from you.

songs.title: Timing the Task
songs.purposeAr: مدة العمل والانتظار والوقت المستغرق
songs.pronunciationFocus: Sing takes and took distinctly; pronounce numbers and duration units clearly.

songs.title: Tomorrow's Promises
songs.purposeAr: الوعود والتوقعات والمستقبل القريب

songs.title: Let Me Tell the Story

songs.title: The Smallest and the Best

songs.title: This One Costs Too Much

songs.title: You Look Like Sunshine

songs.title: I Know, I Believe, I Guess
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-055 - I Know, I Believe, I Guess

songs.title: Can I Tell You a Secret?

songs.title: The Word I Was Looking For

songs.title: I'm Ready for the Next Step

songs.title: Start with One Good Question
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-059 - Start with One Good Question

songs.title: Have You Ever Been There?

songs.title: Since Then, All This Time

examples.english: Tom thinks he knows where Mary went.
examples.arabic: يظن توم أنه يعرف إلى أين ذهبت ماري.

examples.english: Tom wants to know why you didn't call him back.
examples.arabic: يريد توم أن يعرف لماذا لم تعاود الاتصال به.

examples.english: Tom understood what Mary was saying.
examples.arabic: فهم توم ما كانت ماري تقوله.

practice.transferCue: Report something a friend wondered about.

songs.title: Asked Me To Do It
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-071 - Asked Me To Do It
songs.purposeAr: نقل طلب أو دعوة أو عرض فعل
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep the person after asked and to before the base verb; make not to audible as a unit.

examples.english: I asked him to go to my room for my glasses.
examples.arabic: طلبت منه أن يذهب إلى غرفتي ليحضر نظارتي.

examples.english: Tom asked me to open the window.
examples.arabic: طلب مني توم أن أفتح النافذة.

examples.arabic: طلب توم من ماري أن تقبّله.

examples.english: Tom asked me to help when he was in trouble.
examples.arabic: طلب مني توم المساعدة عندما وقع في مشكلة.

examples.english: I was told to wait here.
Tom asked Mary not to leave him alone.
examples.arabic: طلب توم من ماري ألا تتركه وحده.

examples.arabic: طلب توم من ماري رقم هاتفها.

examples.arabic: دعاني توم إلى منزله بعد المدرسة.

examples.arabic: عرض توم إطعام قطتي أثناء غيابي عن المدينة.

practice.transferCue: Say what someone asked you to do.

songs.title: We Came Here To Help
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-072 - We Came Here To Help
songs.purposeAr: المصدر للدلالة على غرض الحركة والتواصل
songs.pronunciationFocus: Let to introduce the purpose phrase; keep the action that comes before it clear.

examples.english: I came to thank you.

I can recommend a good lawyer.
I can teach you how to dance.
All you need to do is remember these three very simple steps.
examples.arabic: كل ما عليك فعله هو تذكر هذه الخطوات الثلاث البسيطة جدًا.

practice.transferCue: Say why you went to a place using to.

songs.title: Keep It Kind
songs.purposeAr: النهي المهذب والنصيحة في العلاقات
songs.pronunciationFocus: Make don't and not distinct; use a friendly tone even when a line sets a boundary.

examples.arabic: لا تضيع وقتك في محاولة إقناع توم.

examples.arabic: لا تتحدث عن الناس من وراء ظهورهم.

examples.english: Don't be so selfish.
examples.arabic: لا تكن أنانيًا إلى هذا الحد.

examples.arabic: لا تتكلف عناء اصطحابي من الفندق.

examples.english: Don't call me when I'm at the office.
examples.arabic: لا تتصل بي عندما أكون في المكتب.

examples.english: Don't hesitate to ask if you want anything.
examples.arabic: لا تتردد في السؤال إن أردت أي شيء.

examples.english: Don't worry about the results of your test.
Don't be afraid to ask questions.

practice.transferCue: Give someone a kind reminder.

songs.title: Don't Take It the Wrong Way
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-074 - Don't Take It the Wrong Way
songs.purposeAr: توضيح القصد وتصحيح سوء الفهم
songs.pronunciationFocus: Make didn't, don't and nothing fully audible; keep the clause after say or mean intact.

examples.english: I didn't think Tom was your type.
examples.arabic: لم أظن أن توم يناسب ذوقك.

examples.arabic: للتوضيح، لم تكن لتوم أي علاقة بهذا الأمر.

Don't tell me you forgot.
Are you telling me you don't remember where you parked your car?
examples.arabic: هل تقول لي إنك لا تتذكر أين أوقفت سيارتك؟

examples.english: Tom made it clear that he didn't like the food.
examples.arabic: أوضح توم أنه لم يعجبه الطعام.

practice.transferCue: Clarify what you did not say or mean.

songs.title: There Is Nothing Left
songs.purposeAr: التعبير عن غياب الخيار وما بقي للفعل أو القول
songs.pronunciationFocus: Distinguish there's no from there's nothing; keep else and more audible.

examples.english: There are no options.
There's nothing else to talk about.
examples.arabic: لم يعد هناك شيء آخر نتحدث عنه.

examples.english: There's no way we can get this done.
There's really nothing more we can do.
examples.arabic: لم يعد هناك حقًا أي شيء يمكننا فعله.

There's really nothing else to say.
examples.arabic: ليس هناك حقًا أي شيء آخر يقال.

examples.english: There's no time for explanations.
There's no reason to get upset.
There's no sign of infection.
I have no reason to lie to you.

practice.transferCue: Say one thing there is no time for.

songs.title: Something Is Not Quite Right
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-076 - Something Is Not Quite Right
songs.purposeAr: تحديد أمر غامض أو خلل أو إمكانية
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep something, nothing and someone clear; present any describing clause in one thought group.

examples.english: There's something else I need you to do.
examples.arabic: هناك أمر آخر أحتاج منك القيام به.

examples.english: There may be something there.
examples.arabic: قد يكون هناك شيء في ذلك المكان.

examples.arabic: من الواضح أن خطأ قد وقع.

examples.arabic: لا يوجد خلل في هذه الدراجة.

examples.arabic: هناك مكان واحد فقط يُرجح أن يختبئ فيه توم.

examples.arabic: هناك أشياء كثيرة أريد أن أريك إياها.

examples.english: There's room for discussion.

practice.transferCue: Say there is something wrong with an object.

songs.title: What Really Matters
songs.purposeAr: حصر المقصود أو المطلوب باستعمال all وonly
songs.pronunciationFocus: Give all, only and the following subject room; pause where the focus statement turns.

examples.english: All I want for Christmas is a guitar.

The only thing that Tom drinks is coffee.
examples.arabic: الشيء الوحيد الذي يشربه توم هو القهوة.

examples.arabic: كل ما أستطيع فعله في الوقت الحالي هو الانتظار.

examples.english: All we can do is wait for the police to arrive.
examples.arabic: كل ما يمكننا فعله هو انتظار وصول الشرطة.

examples.english: All you can do is trust one another.
examples.arabic: كل ما يمكنكم فعله هو أن تثقوا ببعضكم.

examples.english: All you care about is yourself.
examples.arabic: كل ما تهتم به هو نفسك.

examples.arabic: كل ما تتحدث عنه دائمًا هو العمل.

examples.arabic: كل ما نعرفه هو أن توم مذنب.

practice.transferCue: Say all you want or all you have.

songs.title: That's What I Mean
songs.purposeAr: الإشارة إلى الفكرة أو الطريقة أو السبب
songs.pronunciationFocus: Stress what, how, why and way where they focus meaning; keep this and that's distinct.

examples.arabic: هذه هي الطريقة التي تعلم بها الإنجليزية.

examples.english: This is the only way I know how to do this.
examples.arabic: هذه هي الطريقة الوحيدة التي أعرفها لفعل هذا.

examples.english: That's the reason I'm here.

examples.arabic: الحقيقة أنني لم أرد تناول الطعام مع توم.

examples.english: This is why I quit the job.

practice.transferCue: Say this is why and give a reason.

songs.title: That's the One Who Did It
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-079 - That's the One Who Did It
songs.purposeAr: تحديد شخص أو مكان بعبارة موصولة
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep the antecedent attached to who, whose, where or that; use a natural pause after the larger phrase.

songs.title: I Decided to Tell the Truth

songs.title: Reason and Result

songs.title: A Chance or a Certainty

Exactly how much money was stolen?

examples.arabic: تحقق مما إذا كان الغاز مغلقًا.

examples.english: Let's concentrate on what needs to be done today.
examples.arabic: لنركز على ما يجب إنجازه اليوم.

examples.english: The best way to learn a language is to live in a country where it's spoken.
examples.arabic: أفضل طريقة لتعلم لغة هي العيش في بلد تُتحدث فيه تلك اللغة.

practice.transferCue: Say what should be cleaned or repaired.

songs.title: Good At, Worried About
songs.purposeAr: وصف الحالة والاهتمام بحروف الجر المناسبة
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep at, about, to and with clear before their complements; avoid stretching the function word.

examples.english: I'm worried about Tom's health.
I'm good at math.
I'm allergic to cigarette smoke.
I'm fed up with your complaining.
I've had enough of your complaining.
I'm aware of what's going on.
I'm surprised you didn't know that.
examples.arabic: أنا متفاجئ لأنك لم تكن تعرف ذلك.

examples.english: I was surprised to find out that Tom had children.
examples.arabic: فوجئت عندما علمت أن لدى توم أطفالًا.

examples.english: I was disappointed that you didn't call.
examples.arabic: شعرت بخيبة أمل لأنك لم تتصل.

examples.english: I'm prepared for the worst.

practice.transferCue: Say one thing you are good at or worried about.

songs.title: I Can't Get It Off My Mind
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-090 - I Can't Get It Off My Mind
songs.purposeAr: التعبير عن الانشغال بشيء أو ضيق الصدر أو عدم الاكتراث
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep can't, don't and no fully audible; take a breath at the semicolon in the long shopping sentence.

examples.english: I can't stand this hot weather.
I can't stop thinking about what they did to me.
examples.arabic: لا أستطيع التوقف عن التفكير فيما فعلوه بي.

examples.english: I can't help thinking about Tom.
examples.arabic: لا أستطيع منع نفسي من التفكير في توم.

examples.english: I can't put up with this noise anymore.
It doesn't matter what I think.
I don't care how much it costs; I'm going to buy it anyway.
examples.arabic: لا يهمني كم يكلف؛ سأشتريه على أي حال.

examples.english: I don't care who Tom talks to.
examples.arabic: لا يهمني مع من يتحدث توم.

examples.english: I don't care what Tom did.
It's no use complaining.
All you do is criticize others.
examples.arabic: كل ما تفعله هو انتقاد الآخرين.

practice.transferCue: Say one thing you cannot stop thinking about.

songs.title: A Hard Time, A Good Try
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-091 - A Hard Time, A Good Try
songs.purposeAr: الصعوبة والنجاح والمحاولة في إنجاز أمر
songs.pronunciationFocus: Stress hard, trouble and difficult, and let the following infinitive or -ing action stay intact.

examples.english: I find it difficult to express myself in French.
examples.arabic: أجد صعوبة في التعبير عن نفسي بالفرنسية.

examples.english: I had a hard time finding his house.
examples.arabic: واجهت صعوبة في العثور على منزله.

examples.english: I'm having trouble understanding you.
It's hard to figure out who's telling the truth.
examples.arabic: من الصعب معرفة من يقول الحقيقة.

examples.english: Tom found it difficult to understand Mary.
examples.arabic: وجد توم صعوبة في فهم ماري.

examples.english: Tom finds it difficult to keep up with the rest of the class.
examples.arabic: يجد توم صعوبة في مجاراة بقية الصف.

examples.english: I managed to get there in time.
examples.arabic: تمكنت من الوصول إلى هناك في الوقت المناسب.

examples.english: I was able to finish the work earlier than I had expected.
examples.arabic: تمكنت من إنهاء العمل أبكر مما توقعت.

examples.english: Tom managed to put the fire out by himself.
examples.arabic: تمكن توم من إخماد الحريق بنفسه.

practice.transferCue: Say one thing you find difficult to do.

songs.title: Advice or a Choice
songs.purposeAr: طلب النصيحة وذكر الواجب والضغط وتحمل المسؤولية
songs.pronunciationFocus: Separate advise you to, asked for and insisted on; keep the negative in no choice audible.

examples.english: I advise you to stop smoking.
It's important to follow a strict diet.
examples.arabic: من المهم اتباع نظام غذائي صارم.

examples.english: Tom asked for my advice.
No one has the right to tell you how to live your life.
examples.arabic: ليس لأحد الحق في أن يملي عليك كيف تعيش حياتك.

examples.english: I had no choice but to do what Tom asked me to do.
examples.arabic: لم يكن أمامي خيار سوى أن أفعل ما طلبه توم مني.

examples.english: Tom insisted on paying for dinner.
examples.arabic: أصر توم على دفع ثمن العشاء.

examples.english: Tom agreed to help Mary with her work.
examples.arabic: وافق توم على مساعدة ماري في عملها.

examples.english: Do you really expect me to give you money?
examples.arabic: هل تتوقع حقًا أن أعطيك مالًا؟

examples.english: There must be a way we can convince Tom to work for us.
examples.arabic: لا بد أن هناك طريقة لإقناع توم بالعمل لدينا.

examples.english: Tom blames Mary for everything.
examples.arabic: يلوم توم ماري على كل شيء.

practice.transferCue: Give someone one piece of advice.

songs.title: Enough Space to Speak
songs.purposeAr: القدرة والإمكان تحت قيود الوقت والجهد
songs.pronunciationFocus: Contrast can, can't and couldn't; keep the limiting word enough, only or time audible.

examples.english: I could do this myself.
Tom was unable to find Mary a good job.
examples.arabic: لم يتمكن توم من إيجاد وظيفة جيدة لماري.

examples.english: Tom can't afford to buy a new bicycle.
examples.arabic: لا يستطيع توم تحمل تكلفة شراء دراجة جديدة.

examples.english: I have no time to engage in gossip.
examples.arabic: ليس لدي وقت للانشغال بالقيل والقال.

examples.english: I really didn't have time.
I don't have time to finish my homework.
examples.arabic: ليس لدي وقت لإنهاء واجبي المدرسي.

examples.english: I can't keep lying to Tom.
examples.arabic: لا أستطيع مواصلة الكذب على توم.

examples.english: I can't imagine living without electricity.
examples.arabic: لا أستطيع تخيل العيش دون كهرباء.

examples.english: I can't make that decision without talking to Tom first.
examples.arabic: لا أستطيع اتخاذ ذلك القرار قبل التحدث مع توم أولًا.

examples.english: I can't understand why Tom hates me.

practice.transferCue: Say why you can't do something yet.

songs.title: A Place for Another Idea
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-094 - A Place for Another Idea
songs.purposeAr: تنظيم الحديث وإضافة معلومة أو الانتقال إلى موضوع
songs.pronunciationFocus: Let the opening marker be light but clear; use a short pause before the main thought.

examples.english: By the way, where are you from?
As I told you before, I have no choice.
examples.arabic: كما أخبرتك من قبل، ليس لدي خيار.

examples.english: Keep in mind that Tom doesn't speak French very well.
examples.arabic: ضع في حسبانك أن توم لا يتحدث الفرنسية جيدًا جدًا.

examples.english: As usual, Tom was late.
In addition to being a doctor, he was a very famous novelist.
examples.arabic: بالإضافة إلى كونه طبيبًا، كان روائيًا مشهورًا جدًا.

examples.english: In general, kids like ice cream.
Needless to say, we were very tired by the end of the day.
examples.arabic: لا داعي للقول إننا كنا متعبين جدًا في نهاية اليوم.

examples.english: As far as I know, Tom is still married.
examples.arabic: على حد علمي، ما زال توم متزوجًا.

examples.english: Anyway, it's my problem.
To make matters worse, it began to rain.
examples.arabic: ولزيادة الأمور سوءًا، بدأ المطر يهطل.

practice.transferCue: Move to a new subject with by the way.

songs.title: What I Really Think
songs.purposeAr: الصراحة والتحفظ في إبداء الرأي والتعليق
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep the introductory phrase short, then give the main clause its own stress.

examples.english: To put it bluntly, he's mistaken.
To be honest, I don't understand it.
To tell the truth, I didn't do my homework.
examples.arabic: لأقول الحقيقة، لم أنجز واجبي المدرسي.

examples.english: Frankly speaking, this novel isn't very interesting.
examples.arabic: بصراحة، هذه الرواية ليست مشوقة جدًا.

examples.english: In a way, I'm glad I never met Tom.
examples.arabic: من ناحية ما، أنا سعيد لأنني لم أقابل توم قط.

examples.english: Apparently, I was wrong.
Clearly, that was a mistake.
examples.arabic: من الواضح أن ذلك كان خطأ.

examples.english: In fact, I don't think that was Tom.
examples.arabic: في الواقع، لا أظن أن ذلك كان توم.

examples.english: Obviously, Tom isn't Mary's type.
examples.arabic: من الواضح أن توم لا يوافق ذوق ماري.

examples.english: I had a feeling you would be late.
Tom actually likes Mary.

practice.transferCue: State your opinion with to be honest.

songs.title: If It Happens, Call Me
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-096 - If It Happens, Call Me
songs.purposeAr: شرط واقعي وخطة احتياط وردّ عملي
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep if and in case clear without slowing the entire sentence; allow a short pause between condition and instruction.

examples.english: In case something happens to me, I'd like you to take care of my children.
examples.arabic: إن حدث لي مكروه، فأود منك أن تعتني بأطفالي.

examples.english: Call me if something happens.
It doesn't bother me if you take that book.
examples.arabic: لا يزعجني أن تأخذ ذلك الكتاب.

examples.english: What should I do if Tom calls?
examples.arabic: ماذا ينبغي أن أفعل إذا اتصل توم؟

examples.english: What would happen if I push this button?
examples.arabic: ماذا سيحدث لو ضغطت هذا الزر؟

examples.english: What if I refuse?
Even if I knew, I wouldn't tell you.
examples.arabic: حتى لو كنت أعرف، فلن أخبرك.

examples.english: Tom would do anything for you.
examples.arabic: قد يفعل توم أي شيء من أجلك.

examples.english: I don't care if you like me or not.
examples.arabic: لا يهمني إن كنت تحبني أم لا.

practice.transferCue: Tell someone what to do if plans change.

songs.title: Even Then I Keep Going
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-097 - Even Then I Keep Going
songs.purposeAr: التنازل والمقابلة مع even وno matter
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep even if, even though, even when and no matter distinguishable; let the main clause land clearly.

examples.english: Even though it was raining, we decided to take a walk.
examples.arabic: مع أنها كانت تمطر، قررنا الخروج للتمشّي.

examples.english: As strange as it may sound, what Tom said is true.
examples.arabic: على غرابة ما قد يبدو عليه الأمر، فإن ما قاله توم صحيح.

examples.english: Even when she's not wearing makeup, she's very beautiful.
examples.arabic: إنها جميلة جدًا حتى عندما لا تضع مستحضرات التجميل.

examples.english: No matter what you say, I won't change my mind.
No matter who says so, it's not true.
examples.arabic: مهما كان من يقول ذلك، فهو غير صحيح.

examples.english: I don't care which choice you make.
I don't care where you're from.
No matter where you go, I'll follow you.
No matter how much she eats, she never gains weight.
examples.arabic: مهما أكلت، فإن وزنها لا يزيد أبدًا.

practice.transferCue: Say what you did even though something was difficult.

songs.title: If I Could Turn Back Time
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-098 - If I Could Turn Back Time
songs.purposeAr: التمني والحسرة والبديل في الماضي
songs.pronunciationFocus: Make wish plus had, could have and ought to have separately recoverable; no swallowed auxiliaries.

examples.english: I wish I had a beautiful girlfriend.
examples.arabic: أتمنى لو كانت لدي حبيبة جميلة.

examples.english: Tom wishes he had a larger office.
examples.arabic: يتمنى توم لو كان لديه مكتب أكبر.

examples.english: Tom wished Mary were with him.
examples.arabic: تمنى توم لو كانت ماري معه.

examples.english: In retrospect, Tom wishes he had spent more time studying.
examples.arabic: عندما يسترجع توم الماضي، يتمنى لو أمضى وقتًا أطول في الدراسة.

examples.english: I wish I had studied French when I was in high school.
examples.arabic: أتمنى لو درست الفرنسية عندما كنت في المدرسة الثانوية.

examples.english: I ought to have attended the lecture.
What would have happened if Tom had come?
examples.arabic: ماذا كان سيحدث لو جاء توم؟

examples.english: I could have helped you with your work.

practice.transferCue: Say one thing you wish you had done differently.

songs.title: The More, the Better
songs.purposeAr: المقارنة المتلازمة وتغيّر نتيجتين معًا
songs.pronunciationFocus: Stress both comparison anchors; preserve the first and second clauses even when the line is long.

examples.english: The more I think about it, the less I understand it.
examples.arabic: كلما فكرت في الأمر أكثر، قل فهمي له.

examples.english: The more you have, the more you want.
examples.arabic: كلما امتلكت أكثر، رغبت في المزيد.

examples.english: The longer you wait to tell Tom, the harder it's going to be.
examples.arabic: كلما تأخرت في إخبار توم، أصبح الأمر أصعب.

examples.english: The sooner you leave, the better.
examples.arabic: كلما غادرت أبكر، كان ذلك أفضل.

examples.english: What caused the budget deficit?
examples.arabic: ما الذي تسبب في عجز الميزانية؟

examples.english: What makes you so sure that this won't happen again?
examples.arabic: ما الذي يجعلك واثقًا إلى هذا الحد بأن هذا لن يتكرر؟

examples.english: What made her do that?
examples.arabic: ما الذي دفعها إلى فعل ذلك؟

examples.english: How did you manage to talk Tom into working for you?
examples.arabic: كيف تمكنت من إقناع توم بالعمل لديك؟

examples.english: How could this all happen?
examples.arabic: كيف أمكن أن يحدث كل هذا؟

examples.english: How come you know French so well?
examples.arabic: كيف تجيد الفرنسية إلى هذا الحد؟

practice.transferCue: Say how practice changes confidence.

songs.title: Persuade, Ask, or Let
songs.purposeAr: التأثير في فعل شخص آخر والإقناع والسماح
songs.pronunciationFocus: Keep made me plus the plain verb separate from persuaded to and talked into -ing.

examples.english: Don't make me angry.
You make me laugh.
Don't make me say it twice.
Tom kept me waiting for more than 30 minutes.
examples.arabic: جعلني توم أنتظر أكثر من ثلاثين دقيقة.

examples.english: Tom allowed Mary to go home early.
examples.arabic: سمح توم لماري بالعودة إلى المنزل مبكرًا.

examples.english: Tom talked Mary into donating some money.
examples.arabic: أقنع توم ماري بالتبرع ببعض المال.

examples.english: Tom persuaded Mary to go to Boston with him.
examples.arabic: أقنع توم ماري بالذهاب معه إلى بوسطن.

examples.english: I encourage Tom to learn French.
Tom advised Mary to go to the police.
examples.arabic: نصح توم ماري بالذهاب إلى الشرطة.

examples.english: Tom made me swear not to tell Mary about what he did.
examples.arabic: جعلني توم أقسم ألا أخبر ماري بما فعله.

practice.transferCue: Say how someone persuaded you to try something.

songs.title: Not All That Simple
songs.purposeAr: التقييم الدقيق والرد على الكلام المبالغ فيه
songs.pronunciationFocus: Preserve negative and emphatic particles; separate the introductory phrase and the judgment on longer lines.

examples.english: It didn't surprise me at all that Tom couldn't afford a lawyer.
examples.arabic: لم يفاجئني إطلاقًا أن توم لم يستطع تحمل أتعاب محامٍ.

examples.english: It's okay to make a couple of mistakes.
examples.arabic: لا بأس بارتكاب خطأين أو بضعة أخطاء.

examples.english: I don't consider myself to be good-looking.
It's worth talking about.
It's fun to ride a motorcycle.
It's rude to point at people.
examples.arabic: من غير المهذب الإشارة إلى الناس بالأصبع.

examples.english: Not only can't I tell Tom, I can't even tell you.
examples.arabic: ليس الأمر أنني لا أستطيع إخبار توم فقط؛ بل لا أستطيع حتى إخبارك أنت.

examples.english: It never occurred to me that he might be an escaped prisoner.
examples.arabic: لم يخطر ببالي قط أنه قد يكون سجينًا هاربًا.

examples.english: It was stupid of you to believe Tom.
examples.arabic: كان من الحماقة أن تصدق توم.

practice.transferCue: Give a careful opinion about a difficult choice.

songs.title: A Story With a Turn
songs.displayTitle: EP-REF-SONG-102 - A Story With a Turn
songs.purposeAr: الإشارة إلى لحظة التحوّل وما سبقها في السرد
songs.pronunciationFocus: Pause at real clause boundaries; keep the full no sooner and than frame, and keep had lost distinct from found.

examples.english: Fortunately, Tom survived.
So far, I've told no one.
I'm lucky to be here.
I had a premonition that this would happen.
examples.arabic: كان لدي إحساس مسبق بأن هذا سيحدث.

examples.english: Tom probably thought I was at school.
examples.arabic: ربما ظن توم أنني كنت في المدرسة.

examples.english: Tom found the keys he thought he had lost.
examples.arabic: وجد توم المفاتيح التي ظن أنه فقدها.

examples.english: Suddenly, it became noisy.
No sooner had it stopped raining than a beautiful rainbow appeared.
examples.arabic: ما إن توقف المطر حتى ظهر قوس قزح جميل.

practice.transferCue: Tell one short story about an unexpected turn.
